name: OX PetCare Booking
author: Oxplugins

sections.description:
PetCare Booking Suite is a complete booking management system for service-based businesses. Customers book online with a modern, mobile-friendly form and pay at the appointment; you manage appointments, services, providers and customers from the WordPress admin.

Features:

  • Online Booking Form – Mobile-friendly booking form in two layouts (classic and compact), with colours and logo you choose
  • Pay at Location – Customers book without paying online and pay at the appointment, with your own payment instructions
  • Insurance Billing – Optional “Insurance” payment choice for businesses that bill an insurer; no payment is taken at booking
  • Payment Tracking – Mark each appointment unpaid, partly paid, paid or refunded; payment records already stored (for example from earlier versions) stay visible in revenue totals and the customer’s payment history
  • Service Management – Service categories and services with price and duration
  • Provider Management – Staff with their own working hours, service assignments and availability
  • Availability Management – Working hours, holidays and exceptions per provider, minimum lead time, maximum days in advance and slot interval
  • Customer Management – Customers and their booking history
  • Appointment Dashboard – View and manage all bookings with status tracking
  • Calendar View – Day, week and month calendar views with colour-coded appointments
  • Email Notifications – Customisable email templates for confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, cancellations and reschedules, sent with the WordPress mail function; choose which booking emails are sent and set the from name, from address and reply-to address
  • Owner Alerts – New-booking email to the site owner, plus a new-booking badge and notice in the admin with live updates and optional desktop notifications
  • Customer Dashboard – Logged-in customers can view their bookings, cancel upcoming bookings, reschedule (if you allow it) and update their profile
  • Printable Confirmations – Customers can download or print their booking confirmation
  • Shortcodes, Blocks and Elementor Widgets – Add the booking form, customer dashboard and services list anywhere
  • Currency Settings – Choose the currency, symbol and symbol position
  • No Limits – Unlimited bookings, services, providers and customers; nothing in this plugin needs a licence

A separate Pro add-on with further features is available from oxplugins.com.

External services

This plugin does not contact any external service on its own. The one case below only happens when a customer clicks a share button.

WhatsApp (share link)

The booking confirmation screen shows a “Share via WhatsApp” button. Nothing is sent unless the customer clicks it. Clicking opens https://wa.me/ in a new browser tab with a pre-filled message containing the booking reference, service, date and time, the names of the pets entered for the booking (when the booking has any) and your business name. WhatsApp (Meta) then receives that message text and the visitor’s IP address and browser details. The customer can edit or discard the message before sending it.

  • Service: WhatsApp
  • Service URL: https://wa.me/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ox-petcare-booking folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to PetCare Booking in the admin menu to configure your settings.
  4. Add services, providers, and set up availability.
  5. Use the [oxpcb_booking] shortcode to display the booking form on any page.
  6. Use the [oxpcb_customer_dashboard] shortcode for the customer dashboard.
sections.faq:
What shortcodes are available?

  • [oxpcb_booking] – Displays the booking form (supports style="compact" or style="classic")
  • [oxpcb_customer_dashboard] – Displays the customer dashboard (requires login)
  • [oxpcb_services_list] – Displays a grid of available services

Can customers pay online?

Not with this plugin. Customers book without paying online and pay at the appointment (or, if you enable it, choose insurance billing). You set each appointment’s payment status in the admin when the customer has paid.

Can customers cancel or reschedule their bookings?

Yes. Logged-in customers can cancel any upcoming pending or confirmed booking from the customer dashboard. Rescheduling is on by default and can be turned off under PetCare Booking > Settings > Booking Rules.

Which emails are sent?

Booking confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, cancellations and reschedules, plus a new-booking email to the site owner. Each booking email can be turned on or off, and the templates edited, under PetCare Booking > Settings > Notifications. Emails are sent through WordPress’s own mail function, so any mail plugin you already use for your site also applies.

Can customers book without creating an account?

Yes. Guest booking is supported. Customers who are logged in to an account on your site can see and manage their bookings in the customer dashboard.

Does the plugin send data to other services?

No. The plugin itself makes no requests to outside services. The only exception is the “Share via WhatsApp” button on the booking confirmation, which sends nothing unless the customer clicks it (see External services below).

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. The booking form and dashboard are designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Online payments (Stripe, PayPal, Klarna), deposits and tax, recurring bookings and recurring discounts, SMTP email delivery, email-marketing sync and its opt-in confirmation, SMS notifications, the Telegram, Pushover, ntfy and SMS owner-alert channels, cancellation windows and rules, and the Advanced Features page (including multi-location) have moved to a separate Pro add-on. This plugin keeps the complete pay-at-location booking workflow. Existing data is kept: past payments, recurring series, settings and other records stay in your database
  • The “Send emails for” toggles and a new reply-to address field are now on the Notifications settings page
  • Cancellation simplified: logged-in customers can cancel any upcoming pending or confirmed booking from the customer dashboard
  • The booking form no longer shows an email-marketing opt-in box
  • Removed the optional booking QR code and its verification page: the plugin no longer uses the goQR.me image service. The booking confirmation, printable confirmation, download and WhatsApp and email sharing are unchanged

1.0.8

  • No limits or locked settings: every feature in the plugin works without a licence
  • Plugin identifiers now use a longer, unique prefix; existing bookings, settings, shortcodes and blocks are moved over automatically on update
  • If you use Stripe or Klarna webhooks, update the webhook address shown in the admin notice after updating
  • Security hardening: stricter sanitising of booking form input
  • Removed the Custom CSS setting (add any custom styles under Appearance > Customize > Additional CSS instead); the bundled third-party dropdown library has been removed (customer search now uses the jQuery UI Autocomplete script that ships with WordPress); plugin admin notices now appear only on the plugin’s own screens and can be dismissed
  • Privacy: customers can only join a marketing list through a new, optional, unticked opt-in box on the booking form, and ticking it only sends a confirmation email to the address given for that booking; nothing is sent to Mailchimp, Brevo, MailerLite or Klaviyo until the customer clicks the confirmation link (one-time, expires after 48 hours); QR verification links no longer contain the customer’s email
  • Security: guest bookings are now protected by a private booking key held by the browser that made the booking; paying for, viewing or downloading a booking needs that key (or the customer’s or an administrator’s login), an email address is no longer accepted, and the marketing opt-in applies to each booking separately
  • Security: a booking made without logging in always gets its own new customer record built only from the details typed for it, even if the email matches an existing customer; the existing customer’s details, pets and history are never reused, changed or shown. A logged-in account is only connected to the customer record linked to it (an administrator can link an older record on the customer screen), never to another record by matching email; the plugin’s admin JavaScript is no longer printed inline; the bundled Inter web font was removed (the admin screens use the system font)
  • PayPal: a booking is marked as paid only when PayPal reports the captured payment as completed for this booking’s amount and currency; pending, declined or mismatched payments are never recorded as paid, a repeated confirmation never records a payment twice, and a payment PayPal took but the site could not record is flagged in the booking’s internal notes instead of being shown as confirmed
  • Fixed Klarna checkout on both booking form styles: the deposit or full amount is now fixed on the server when the Klarna session starts, and exactly that amount is authorised, captured, recorded and shown as paid; repeated or out-of-date Klarna requests are refused or answered without charging again
  • Fixed Klarna payments being saved without a payment method; after a declined or cancelled PayPal payment, trying PayPal again now pays for the same booking instead of creating a second one
  • Customers created from a booking made without logging in are marked “Guest (unverified)” in the admin; finished marketing confirmation requests are deleted automatically after 30 days
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1

1.0.7

  • Fixed booking emails not being sent to customers and the site owner for new, cancelled, confirmed and rescheduled bookings
  • Fixed SMTP passwords containing special characters failing to log in; the SMTP test now saves your settings first and sends to your notification address
  • Fixed reminder emails being re-sent every hour and email delivery not being logged
  • Notification page toggles and custom email templates now take effect
  • New: instant owner alerts for new bookings via Telegram, Pushover, ntfy or SMS (Twilio), each with a “Send test alert” button
  • New: dashboard new-booking badge and notice, with live updates and optional desktop notifications

1.0.6

  • Improved Classic booking form design with admin-customisable colours
  • Added SMTP support in free tier for reliable email delivery
  • Fixed booking confirmation download for guest users
  • Fixed provider service filtering by category
  • Improved form parity between Classic and Compact layouts
  • Security improvements and code quality enhancements

1.0.5

  • Added breadcrumb navigation across all admin pages
  • Fixed cross-vertical terminology consistency
  • Improved recurring series appointment management

1.0.0

  • Initial release
